opening.argument: The presentation centers on Litecoin chart analysis, not a promised return. It describes a technical setup and makes the $85 target conditional on Litecoin holding above $75 and reclaiming the $80 zone. The on-screen disclaimer frames the discussion as educational, says it is not financial advice, and warns of trading and investing risks. The description does promote paid signals and mentorship, but those promotions do not establish a deceptive promise, required payment, credential request, victim loss, or an outcome from an external service. The evidence supports market commentary with a qualified forecast, not a guaranteed result.
